messages:
deploy-bot: Canary for release v1.14.0 failed health-check in us-west-2 (5/10). Automatically placing release on HOLD. Reason: increased 5xx rate and kube OOM spikes.
alex-oncall: on it — pulling logs now, will check k8s events and pod oom history.
diego-platform: seeing KV-cache kernel warnings on the inference workers around the same time. Suspect memory regression from recent runtime tweak.
maya-qe: rolling canary traffic back to baseline traffic profile to reproduce locally. Do we want to rollback the canary or pin to previous runtime?
sarah-release: we should avoid a full rollback if a quick pin to last known-good model/runtime combo works. Can we pin model -> v2026-02-14 and runtime -> r2-stable?
diego-platform: yes, r2-stable + model v2026-02-14 had no OOMs in last 72h tests. I can prepare the pin and a canary swap over the next 20m.
alex-oncall: logs show memory growth after KV cache change: stack trace points to kernel selection change. Tagging @diego-platform for confirmation.
deploy-bot: deploybot: queued pin operation: pin-release v1.14.0 -> model v2026-02-14, runtime r2-stable. ETA 18m.
maya-qe: after pin swap, I'll run the quick promptset sanity suite and perf smoke (10K token synth) to confirm no regressions.
sarah-release: Release notes update: add incident note and pinned variant, include rollback instructions. I'll draft and push to the release doc.
ops-bot: Remember to update change window: original change window today 22:00-23:00 PDT. Recommend reschedule to tomorrow 03:00-04:00 UTC to allow post-mortem and extra ops coverage.
diego-platform: agreed. Will hold scheduled regional rollouts until we get green on pinned canary.
alex-oncall: pinned canary swapped, initial metrics look better — 2xx back to baseline, CPU and memory stable so far.
maya-qe: sanity suite passed (smoke 0 failures), perf smoke within expected tail latency.
sarah-release: OK to resume release? We should still move the public rollout to the new window and mark a soft rollback trigger if 5xx > 1% in 15m.
deploy-bot: release hold cleared for canary, global rollout remains PAUSED until change window shift is confirmed.
ops-bot: change window updated: new window 2026-05-12 03:00-04:00 UTC. Notifying downstream teams and updating calendar.
sarah-release: final checklist: 1) release notes updated + incident blurb, 2) pinned runtime/model documented, 3) rollback procedure in doc (manual rollback to v1.13.9), 4) canary metrics baseline captured. Anyone object?
diego-platform: no objections. tagging runbook owners to confirm.
maya-qe: confirm test coverage added to post-release evals.
alex-oncall: will follow the canary for 30m and escalate if anything resurfaces.
sarah-release: thanks everyone. We'll pick this up in the postmortem channel after the release window. :thumbsup:
